card.name: Numbers before fold or times multiples
card.fires_on: A number word or digit that starts a magnitude, often just before 'fold', 'times' or 'to N times' when comparing amounts or doses. Also leading digits of dose or distance figures.

modes.label: Leading digit of a quantity
modes.description: First digit of a dose, time or distance figure.

card.writes: It promotes 'fold' and Chinese words for times or multiples, so it adds a multiplier word after the number.
card.plain: It fires on a number that is about to be followed by 'fold' or 'times', as in 'four-fold higher' or '4 to 6 times the dose'.
